    lower_until_contact()
    open_gripper()
    retreat()
    wait(20)

if not spots or not spots["spots"]:
    raise RuntimeError("No free spot on orange_tray after clearing")

spot = spots["spots"][0]
carry_to(spot["x"], spot["y"], height=0.18, yaw=spot["gripper_yaw"])

retreat()
